ov: اليوم بعد غد (الإنجليزية: The Day After Tomorrow) هو فيلم تم إنتاجه في الولايات المتحدة وكندا وصدر يوم 24 مايو 2004. الفيلم من إخراج رولان إيميريش ومارك جوردن وكتابة رولان إيميريش وجيفري ناشمانوف.
plotEn:
Jack Hall, a paleoclimatologist for NOAA, drills for ice core samples in the Larsen Ice Shelf alongside his colleagues, Frank and Jason. A massive section of the ice shelf suddenly splits away, but they manage to narrowly escape.
At a United Nations conference on global warming in New Delhi, Jack shares his theory that climate change could trigger a new ice age by disrupting the North Atlantic Current. United States Vice President Raymond Becker is dismissive of Jack's research, but Professor Terry Rapson, a Scottish oceanographer, befriends him over their shared concerns.
Tokyo is struck by a giant hailstorm, and astronauts on the International Space Station spot three gigantic superstorms above Canada, Europe, and Siberia. Rapson's team notices severe temperature drops in the North Atlantic, providing evidence that Jack's theory may already be coming true. Meanwhile, the remnants of a hurricane spawn a destructive tornado outbreak across the Los Angeles Basin. Three helicopters sent to rescue the British royal family in Scotland crash after flying through the eye of the European superstorm. 
Jack and Rapson's teams build a forecast model predicting that the climate shift will occur within six to eight weeks, though they later revise this estimate to just seven to ten days. Rapson shares with Jack that super-cooled air siphoned from the upper troposphere will flash-freeze anything caught in the eye of the storm. These cyclones reach temperatures below −150 degrees Fahrenheit
